posts.author: DotMp3
posts.body:
Hey, i'm currently making a game on RPGMMZ, and i was in real need of good medieval, typical High/dark fantasy tilesets, RTP Style. I was looking for something more city-related, but any related tileset would do. And in addition, a good tileset to be used in royal buildings, such as a Castle
(Free if possible lol, i dont have much money)
I do have only MZ, but i also have the VX Ace RTP (just don't know if the converted tilesets would look fine or blurry).

posts.author: Midona018
posts.body:
I know you can find a converted version of Ace RTP to MV/MZ on the forum that looks really good and works with the RTP (maybe with a little change of colors). For a Dark Fantasy tileset, the DLC MV trinity for MZ has a full dark fantasy tileset (and more). But you will need to rework the colors to match MZ RTP.
